definitions.runs: GIK/jobs.json (70: neighbour 20, occ_case1_L2 30, occ_case3 9, orange1345 1, control 10). 1345 baseline run = AG3S-ROI-CARVE-GPU-SMOKE B_ROI_FPR_ep1345_s13453 (the run AG3S-NBC-1345 names as its 'reference')
definitions.t_close: first step with executed_actions grasping-arm gripper command (col 7 left / 15 right) < 0.9
definitions.never_closes: q_ref = same-seed no-obstacle VLA-alone run's t_close joints (regression: VLA alone draw 0 of the same scene/seed; occlusion: OCC-APPLE-1345 round4 VLA_noobst_s<seed>); scene state replayed to min(that t_close, last row of the run)
definitions.scene_state: hold_w reset + 1000 warm-up mj_steps + applied_ctrl of rows t_step < t_state; fidelity = qpos mismatch rows
definitions.hand_frame: MuJoCo site <side>_ee (hold link stand-in; position check vs URDF ee_<side> in the observed stage is recorded)
definitions.approach_axis: site z axis, sign toward the apple centre at the state
definitions.tilt: about unit(a x -z) through the apple centre; positive = approach axis toward -z (downward vertical)
definitions.candidate_order: tilt, then yaw about world z through the apple centre, then world translation
definitions.ik: DLS lambda 0.05, step clip 0.2 rad, joint limits clamped, start q_ref, <=100 iterations; converged = pos <= 2 mm and rot <= 2 deg
definitions.deviation: |p - p_ref| mm + rotation angle deg x 2 mm/deg, achieved FK poses of the hand frame
definitions.gt_i: hand = collision geoms of subtree(EE_BODY_<S>) + subtree(ee_finger_<s>1) + subtree(ee_finger_<s>2); fingers at the state's opening (open); neighbour = non-target fruit bodies; obstacle = obstacle manager collision geoms; table = every other collision geom not robot / fruit / obstacle (crate included; crate also reported alone); mj_geomDistance capped at 50 mm
definitions.gt_ii: from the state: grasping arm qpos = candidate, qvel 0, arm ctrl = candidate (actuator hold, not kinematic lock), grasping gripper ctrl 0 (closed command), rest unchanged; 9 control steps x spa sub-steps; counts per sub-step; neighbour displacement = max body displacement of non-target fruits from the test start
definitions.grasp: finger opening (qpos / RBY1_GRIPPER_OPEN) >= 0.6 at the end AND apple centre between the fingers (finger point = mean centre of that finger subtree's collision geoms; segment parameter in (0,1), distance to the segment <= apple collision geom rbound)
definitions.rule1: converged & hand-neighbour >= 5 mm & hand-obstacle >= 5 mm & hand-table >= 0 mm & (ii) hand-neighbour contacts 0 & apple-neighbour contacts 0 & grasp
definitions.rule2: converged & (ii) neighbour displacement <= 5 mm & robot(any geom)-obstacle contacts 0 & hand-table contacts 0 & grasp ('장애물 · 테이블 접촉' subject = robot for obstacle (the occlusion evaluation counts robot-obstacle), hand for table)
definitions.pick: min deviation among the rule's set (lowest candidate index on ties); rule 3 = no candidate in rule 1 or 2
definitions.ii_evaluation: exhaustive: (ii) is run for every converged candidate (no lazy shortcut)
definitions.observed: serving runs only (VLA-alone runs have no recorded field: bare-policy server, no server_constraints). Request = last planning row with t_step <= t_close (the request that commanded the close; for never-closing runs t_state). Rows = TrajOpt's own field row values (sc_common.rows: d - r - margin, authorised links read the target-free layer) with server args + --palm-shell on --obstacle-margin 0.005 (obstacle/neighbour margin 5 mm; support/target margins as the server sets them), code tree snapshot_scpt. Observed clearance = min over the grasping hand's spheres (palm link ee_<side>, finger links, palm_shell spheres of that hand) at the candidate joints (H = candidate columns, finger path row 0). Plane rows reported, not used in the rule. Observed pick = min deviation among converged candidates with observed clearance >= 0 mm. Closing cannot be judged in the observed world.
definitions.agreement: observed pick is GT rule 1 or 2 (i.e. in GT set r1 or r2 of that candidate)

criteria.b: observed pick in GT r1|r2 / runs with an observed pick >= 80 % (denominator reported)
criteria.c: control 10 runs: GT pick deviation == 0 (reference candidate chosen) >= 9

definitions.tolerances: deviation 0 = the reference candidate (index of params 0,0,0,0,0; its IK returns q_ref with zero iterations)
definitions.to_reach: fixed in gik_to.py docstring 2026-10-27 09:11 UTC before the first TO number: per serving run with GT rule 1/2, the last 3 planning requests with t_step < t_close; E1-C cost (w_grasp_tcp 0, w_grasp_goal 2000); anchor = server gate rebuilt from the record with its goal replaced by the URDF palm ee_<side> origin at the GT pick joints; reach = max palm error over the goal rows <= 10 mm AND TrajOpt status feasible

definitions.terms: problem.objective terms evaluated separately with the server's weights: track = w_track * sum_k decay^k sum_j scale_j (Q-R)^2 (scale = recorded to.metrics.joint_track_scale, else 1); smooth = w_smooth * sum (second difference of Q)^2; continuity = w_continuity * sum over the first min(8, overlap) rows (Q - previous executed chunk aligned at n_exec)^2; deflection_rate = w_deflection_rate * (sum ||D_{k+1}-D_k||^2 + ||D_0 - d_hist||^2), D = Q - R, d_hist = last applied row - previous reference at that row (0 when the deflection-rate gate is off for the chunk); violation_price = w_slack * merit violation, taken from the server record (to.metrics.initial_violation_m for (a), candidates[returned_index].violation_m for (b)); the offline reconstruction (ta_offline scene) only when not recorded (returned = projection) and as a separate cross-check (gate open: window (rows 0-7) + tail (rows 8-15) worst violation; gate closed: window optimizer, rows 0-7 full violation). Changed 2026-10-27 23:10 KST after the first aggregate: the reconstruction differed from the record in some latched / held requests (e.g. +10.0 mm = obstacle_margin on rows the server exempts); before the change the reconstruction was used for every request; grasp_goal = grasp_anchor.anchor_cost with the recorded goal_m, goal_rows, w_goal (w_tcp path term when > 0). merit = sum.
definitions.a_b: (a) = reference_chunk as the trajectory (R = Q -> track and deflection inner terms 0), (b) = recorded refined_chunk; horizon = 8 rows when the recorded look-ahead gate is closed (window optimizer), 16 when open
definitions.modified_request: max |refined - reference| over left-arm joints rows 0-7 > 0.01 deg (raw value reported)
definitions.close: t_close = first control step with executed_actions[:, 7] (left gripper) < 0.9 (GIK definition); close request = last request whose client control step <= t_close; 'before the close' = requests 0 .. close_request-1
definitions.dominant_term: per modified request, the term with the largest |b - a|; 'decreasing term' = the term with the most negative b - a; both also among the cost terms only (violation price excluded)
definitions.merit_crosscheck: |merit(a) - recorded initial_merit| (initial iterate = reference: warm_start_lookahead off, window horizon 8 = execution length, no stay start) and |merit(b) - recorded merit of the returned candidate| (returned = accepted); reported as max abs and max rel
definitions.merit_crosscheck_tolerance: mismatch = |mine - recorded| > 1e-4 * max(|recorded|, 1e-3); set 2026-10-27 23:00 KST after seeing the first 3 runs (max rel 1.9e-5 outside 5 post-close held requests of one run)
definitions.palm: URDF link ee_left origin by the snapshot's robot FK, refined vs reference, rows 0-7, mm
definitions.apple: MuJoCo body 'apple' xpos at the request's client step qpos (scene_truth with the run's obstacle config); target centroid = recorded target_centroid
definitions.fixed_at: 2026-10-27 22:58-23:10 KST, before the aggregate was computed (first raw file looked at only for the merit cross-check)
